elsewhere.note: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites was coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices…
Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then isn’t the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
